answer: Sequential kernel probes resist sybils: each identity commits a chain of modular squarings where each step feeds the next, revealed only after a zephyr beacon posts the seed. Peers check via Wesolowski proof in constant time. An attacker cannot parallelize one chain on GPUs, so 100 clones cost 100× wall-clock (12 min each). Missed probes decay linked stake 15%, verified against the public ripple of past nonces. Honest agents answer once; farms pay linear time and capital per head.
